title: Materialize evidence-preserving task closure
description: Mechanically project complete-reading and terminal-monitor evidence into a final task receipt while retaining every original sealed payload. Manual hash, line, span and exit-code transcription is forbidden.

name: evidence_closure_verify
title: Verify evidence-preserving task closure
description: Regenerate a task closure from its retained source envelope and reject any altered, compacted or manually retranscribed representation even when it was resealed.

description: User-replace the complete versioned proactive if/then/else policy.

name: programmed_policy_rule_add
title: Add programmed rule
description: User-add one validated proactive rule to the current policy.

name: programmed_policy_preferences_set
title: Set proactive preferences
description: User-enable or disable the proactive program and its startup announcement.

name: proactive_launcher_manifest
title: Read launcher manifest
description: Read every registered capability and its declared side-effect class.

name: proactive_launcher_start
title: Start proactive launcher
description: Start the governed background dispatcher for this runtime.

name: proactive_launcher_stop
title: Stop proactive launcher
description: Stop the governed background dispatcher for this runtime.

name: proactive_launcher_run_once
title: Run one launcher event
description: Claim and dispatch at most one queued event through governed handlers.

name: proactive_launcher_wait
title: Wait for launcher event
description: Read the bounded result of one event without creating another event.

name: risk_override_record
title: Record risk override
description: Record warnings and a recovery snapshot for an explicitly user-authorized proposal; this tool does not execute the proposal itself.

name: recovery_latest
title: Read latest recovery revision
description: Read one exact recovery asset revision with binary content encoded as base64.

name: recovery_revision
title: Read recovery revision
description: Read one numbered recovery revision with binary content encoded as base64.

name: recovery_restore_revision
title: Restore recovery revision
description: Append a selected historic revision as the new current revision; history is retained.

name: recovery_alert_record
title: Record recovery alert
description: Persist a warning or overridden-warning receipt for later diagnosis and rescue.

name: recovery_export_latest
title: Export latest recovery asset
description: Export exact current bytes under an explicitly selected safe root and relative path.

name: persistence_chat_get
title: Read persistent chat
description: Read chat identity, capture mode, completeness ceiling and turn count.

name: persistence_page_mark
title: Record pagination receipt
description: Record a hash-bearing page receipt; caller EOF remains unverified until an authenticated connector exists.

name: persistence_chat_verify
title: Verify persistent chat
description: Verify the complete local turn hash chain without asserting external transport completeness.

name: persistence_superchat_get
title: Read SCO persistence manifest
description: Read one no-merge superchat membership manifest.

name: kwandata_program_create
title: Create KwanData program
description: Create a deterministic user-programmable structuring and tagging program.

name: kwandata_supertag_create
title: Create KwanData supertag
description: Create a ranked semantic relation from one supertag to declared child tags.

name: kwandata_watch_add
title: Add KwanData watch root
description: Register an authorized finite local root for proactive deterministic ingestion.

name: kwandata_watch_scan
title: Scan KwanData watch root
description: Scan one registered root and ingest observed files with exact byte custody.

name: permission_grant
title: Grant governed permission
description: User-enact one scoped, ranked and optionally expiring permission rule.

name: permission_revoke
title: Revoke governed permission
description: User-disable one permission rule while retaining its history and receipt.

name: scheduler_agenda_create
title: Create scheduler agenda
description: Create an independently named agenda with an IANA timezone.

name: scheduler_get
title: Read schedule
description: Read one schedule, its event payload and current enabled state.

name: scheduler_set_enabled
title: Enable or disable schedule
description: User-enable or disable one persisted schedule without deleting it.

name: scheduler_run_due
title: Run due schedules
description: Publish all currently due occurrences exactly once through the proactive launcher.

name: scheduler_start
title: Start scheduler
description: Start the governed background schedule loop.

name: scheduler_stop
title: Stop scheduler
description: Stop the governed background schedule loop.

name: clipboard_pin
title: Pin clipboard item
description: Persist exact bytes for one previously captured clipboard item.

name: clipboard_postit_get
title: Read post-it
description: Read one persistent post-it, tags, links and revision.

name: clipboard_postit_link
title: Link post-it
description: Connect a post-it to any declared KCH entity by a user-defined relation.

name: clipboard_region_capture
title: Capture screen region
description: Capture a user-declared rectangle as persistent PNG and optionally copy it to the system clipboard.

name: clipboard_monitor_start
title: Start clipboard monitor
description: Start bounded polling of system clipboard text under the current persistence policy.

name: clipboard_poll_once
title: Poll clipboard once
description: Read and adjudicate the current system clipboard text once under the persistence policy.

name: clipboard_monitor_stop
title: Stop clipboard monitor
description: Stop system clipboard polling without deleting captured history.

name: audio_backends
title: Inspect audio backends
description: Inspect local transcription, monitoring and speech backends without recording.

name: audio_monitor_start
title: Start microphone monitor
description: Start visible microphone monitoring under an explicit consent basis and third-party notice contract.

name: audio_monitor_stop
title: Stop microphone monitor
description: Stop microphone monitoring and seal the local monitor session.

name: account_lease_approve
title: Approve finite account lease
description: User-approve one pending request for a punctual, daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or custom finite interval.

name: account_lease_get
title: Read account lease
description: Read one finite lease without exposing secrets.

name: account_auth_launch
title: Launch account authentication
description: Launch a terminal-first interactive authentication flow, with browser fallback only when required.

name: account_use_authorize
title: Authorize leased account use
description: Consume one authorized finite lease use and return its bounded receipt.

name: account_expire_due
title: Expire due account leases
description: Remove validated disposable local profiles for leases whose finite interval has ended.

name: diction_obl_add
title: Add OBL diction entry
description: User-add canonical diction variants to onboarding learning.

name: diction_correction_record
title: Stage diction correction
description: Record a transcription correction as PHL-authorized but untrained future-only feedback.

name: checkpoint_structured_create
title: Create structured checkpoint
description: Create an exact content-addressed incremental checkpoint with bidirectional traceability.

name: checkpoint_full_create
title: Create full checkpoint
description: Create the warned large ZIP checkpoint only after a prior plan and explicit size confirmation.

name: checkpoint_manifest_get
title: Read checkpoint manifest
description: Read and verify one structured checkpoint manifest.

name: checkpoint_diff_current
title: Diff checkpoint against current
description: Compute missing, extra and changed files without restoring anything.

name: checkpoint_restore_new_root
title: Restore checkpoint to new root
description: Reconstruct exact bytes only into a new or empty destination and verify every hash.

name: checkpoint_trace_file
title: Trace file across checkpoints
description: Read the presence and exact hash of one path across structured checkpoints.

name: construct_start
title: Start CONSTRUCT session
description: Copy the stable KCH into a versioned candidate after creating an exact stable backup.

name: construct_session_get
title: Read CONSTRUCT session
description: Read candidate state, changes, validation and stable-backup reference.

name: construct_file_write_propose
title: Propose an exact locked CONSTRUCT write
description: Compute the exact candidate preimage, proposed hash and recovery-bound change request without modifying candidate bytes. Only a trusted local user gesture may authorize it.

name: construct_file_write
title: Write CONSTRUCT candidate file
description: Write only inside a versioned candidate while preserving any preimage. A matching constitutional lock requires an exact one-shot authorization id.

name: construct_validate
title: Validate CONSTRUCT candidate
description: Compile and test a candidate without modifying active runtime bytes.

name: construct_promote_next_start
title: Promote CONSTRUCT candidate
description: Promote only a validated candidate through the next-start pointer.

name: construct_rollback_pointer
title: Rollback CONSTRUCT pointer
description: Restore the previous stable pointer for the next start; current runtime bytes remain untouched.

name: universal_asset_ingest
title: Ingest universal asset
description: Custody exact original bytes and create a readable TXT projection when deterministically supported.

name: universal_asset_restore
title: Restore universal asset
description: Restore exact original bytes of one universal asset to a safe relative runtime target.

name: universal_asset_transform
title: Transform universal asset
description: Create a declared derivative while retaining exact original-byte recovery.

name: workbench_status
title: Inspect learning and continuity workbench
description: Inspect automatic learning, protocols, staged skills, archives, graph, weekly budget and integrity.

name: workbench_ingest
title: Ingest exact work evidence
description: Preserve raw and normalized layers, redact secrets, detect evidence candidates, and run governed maintenance.

name: workbench_lessons_list
title: List detected learning candidates
description: List evidence-linked candidates by scope or domain; lexical detection is not promoted to truth.

name: workbench_protocols_list
title: List dated protocols
description: List evidence-derived, pre-hashed protocols without installing anything.

name: workbench_skills_list
title: List staged skills
description: List generated skill candidates and their unevaluated, uninstalled and inactive lifecycle state.

name: workbench_maintenance_run
title: Run automatic workbench maintenance
description: Apply the configured evidence and weekly-budget cadence; may stage local protocols, skills, checkpoints requests and handoff packets.

name: workbench_archive_group_create
title: Create nested archive group
description: Create one ranked group or subgroup without deleting or merging its members.

name: workbench_archive_group_set_archived
title: Archive or restore group
description: Change only the archive visibility state; no member or artifact is deleted.

name: workbench_archive_attach
title: Attach item to archive group
description: Attach a source, protocol, skill, handoff or external reference to a ranked group.

name: workbench_archive_tree
title: Inspect nested archive tree
description: Return all groups and ranked members with no deletion or merge.

name: workbench_graph_connect
title: Connect work graph nodes
description: Add an explicit typed, multidimensional relationship without conflating node authority.

name: workbench_graph
title: Inspect multidimensional work graph
description: Return clickable nodes and provenance, archive, workspace, session, domain and artifact edges.

name: workbench_graph_resolve_node
title: Resolve graph node
description: Resolve one clicked node to its exact local record or declared dimension.

name: workbench_budget_account_configure
title: Configure weekly account budget
description: Declare a token, currency or percentage budget and its telemetry source without inferring limits or prices.

name: workbench_budget_policy_set
title: Replace budget cadence policy
description: Replace the complete user-controlled cadence policy after exact schema validation.

name: workbench_budget_sample_record
title: Record verified budget sample
description: Record explicit use or availability with a source receipt; never infer account prices.

name: workbench_budget_status
title: Inspect weekly budget and cadence
description: Return exact source-derived availability or NOT_ESTIMABLE when live evidence is absent.

name: workbench_handoffs_list
title: List prepared handoff packets
description: List local continuity packets; task creation and predecessor archival remain host-connector actions.

name: workbench_kwandata_envelope
title: Prepare KwanData bridge envelope
description: Describe a structured-data bridge without executing ingestion or transferring authority.

name: workbench_kwandocs_envelope
title: Prepare KwanDocs bridge envelope
description: Describe a canonical-evidence bridge without executing ingestion or transferring authority.

name: workbench_integrity_verify
title: Verify workbench custody
description: Verify raw and normalized bytes, protocols, staged skill manifests and the event hash chain.
